title: All the little things I've noticed about "Amadeus(1984)"..a IMDB "Amadeus" forum tribute

commenti.body: A rich and loving tribute to a rich and wonderful movie! Was a fun read. I too return to this movie often, at least once a year. The opening and closing scenes are among the best in movie history. One of my favourite moments, I think around 1m20s, is the short servant snaffling some of the mascarpone dessert with his mouth.
